items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: I read it in the Times about three days ago... I didn’t know that either.

ctx.x: I didn’t know that either. I read it in the Times about three days ago. I was amazed. So that decision and placing this figurehead in office against the popular vote, I just think it’s a travesty. I do everything I can, I write letters, I write funny things, or try to.
Right. My favorite is Condoleeza Rice sings “Oh What a Beautiful Warning.”
